card.name: Country and government context words
card.fires_on: Words in general web text about nations and governments, such as 'Chinese' before an official body, 'federal, state and local', or place names with 'in'. It also fires on digits inside dates.

card.writes: It seems to push toward world-scale and international words and away from national-scope words like nationwide.
card.plain: It fires on words about countries and governments, and nudges the model toward global wording instead of nationwide wording.
